pricingFaq.question: Cancel platform?
pricingFaq.answer: Contact us to cancel, see T&C for notice period.

pricingFaq.question: Payment methods?
pricingFaq.answer: Credit card or SEPA direct debit, processed securely.

pricingFaq.question: Who bills messages?
pricingFaq.answer: Messages are billed directly by Meta. GetNotify charges only setup and platform fees.

pricingFaq.question: Refunds?
pricingFaq.answer: No refund for messages sent. Platform fees follow T&C notice periods.
